hints.title: Task Count and State Representation
hints.text: Since n is at most 14, represent any subset of completed tasks as a bitmask.

hints.title: Compound State Structure
hints.text: For each bitmask of completed tasks, store a pair (sessions, current_session_time) minimizing the number of sessions, breaking ties with smallest current session time.

hints.title: Bit Transition Logic
hints.text: To add task i to mask: if current_time + tasks[i] <= sessionTime, session count remains the same and time increases; otherwise, start a new session of duration tasks[i].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: sessionTime: maximum capacity of a work session
complexity.notes: Bitmask dynamic programming minimizing session count and residual time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all permutations or partitions takes O(N!) or Bell number complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking optimal (sessions, current_time) per subset explores all 2^N states in order.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize bitmask DP over small N (<= 14) and maintain compound session state.
